articles.headline: Abel puts Berkshire Hathaway's cash to work with $10B Alphabet investment
articles.summary: Berkshire Hathaway's new CEO Greg Abel has been on a spending spree - putting almost $20 billion back into the stock market last quarter. The move reverses three years of selling stocks and building up Berkshire's cash pile by his predecessor Warren Buffett. Some of the key investments included a $10 billion deal to purchase Alphabet common stock - now making it Berkshire's fifth largest holding overall.
